verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly advertises QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite sync plus 'AI-powered automations to close your books faster' (mercury-docs-6), backed by supporting AI features like auto-categorized receipts (mercury-docs-5/28), AI bill reading (mercury-docs-3), and a rich accounting-oriented API (transactions, categories, invoices, webhooks) (mercury-docs-12/13). However, the hosted MCP server exposed to AI agents is read-only (31 get/list tools, no write actions per mercury-probe-5), so agentic automation of actual close-the-books actions (categorizing, reconciling, posting) isn't independently verified beyond marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that the close-books automation actually works end-to-end, and any write-capable AI agent action beyond querying data.
